title.value: Phone the bank to get wire fees refunded

introduction.value:
An AI tool used a synthetic copy of Joshua Browder's voice to call Wells Fargo and ask for a refund of wire transfer fees, settling on three months of fees.
·
Jan 20, 2023

method.value: DoNotPay's tool was built from Resemble.ai for the cloned voice of founder Joshua Browder, the open-source GPT-J model, and DoNotPay's own models for the script. It phoned Wells Fargo and asked for a wire fee refund. When the representative asked for a first and last name, it gave them. It then negotiated the disputed fees. Browder said the bots called Wells Fargo about a dozen times to test the flow.

outcome.value: In the video the call ended with a refund of three months of wire fees. Wells Fargo said the video looked edited. Browder said only his account number was cut. The exchange was stilted, with long pauses.

notes.value: Wells Fargo disputed that the call happened as shown, and the source is a secondhand news write-up, so the result is unverified.

source_text.body:
Phone the bank to get wire fees refunded
An AI tool used a synthetic copy of Joshua Browder's voice to call Wells Fargo and ask for a refund of wire transfer fees, settling on three months of fees.
·
Jan 20, 2023
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
DoNotPay's tool was built from Resemble.ai for the cloned voice of founder Joshua Browder, the open-source GPT-J model, and DoNotPay's own models for the script. It phoned Wells Fargo and asked for a wire fee refund. When the representative asked for a first and last name, it gave them. It then negotiated the disputed fees. Browder said the bots called Wells Fargo about a dozen times to test the flow.
How it went
In the video the call ended with a refund of three months of wire fees. Wells Fargo said the video looked edited. Browder said only his account number was cut. The exchange was stilted, with long pauses.
Worth knowing
Wells Fargo disputed that the call happened as shown, and the source is a secondhand news write-up, so the result is unverified.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
I was charged wire transfer fees by [bank name] on [dates/amounts]. Look up the bank's customer service phone number, fee policy, and refund or complaint process, then write a short call script and a written fallback message asking for a refund of [number] months of fees. Include likely objections and how to respond to them. Don't contact the bank or submit anything; show me the script and message for approval first.
Original source: https://www.naturalnews.com/2023-01-20-bot-successfully-requested-refund-from-wells-fargo.html
